title: EBI-Metagenomics/mag-polishing-pipeline pipeline parameters
description: Improves MAG quality by recruiting additional related samples through sequence similarity search

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

pipeline_options.title: Pipeline options
pipeline_options.description: The knobs this experiment actually turns.

n_concat_samples.description: Co-assembly depths, comma separated. One co-assembly dataset, de novo assembly and MAG per value, capped at the number of usable Branchwater hits.
n_concat_samples.help_text: This is the parameter you sweep to ask how many public runs are worth adding before the MAG stops improving. Each value writes a full pair of concatenated fastqs into the work directory, so a long list is storage hungry: for `1,5,10` one sample writes 2 + 6 + 11 = 19 run-equivalents of fastq.

skip_first_assembly.description: Skip cycle 1 entirely and search Branchwater with the samplesheet genome.
skip_first_assembly.help_text: No cycle-1 assembly, no cycle-1 GGP and no `cycle1` slot in any table. Use it when the sample has already been assembled elsewhere, or when the question is only what the public runs add to a genome you already have.

ena_cache_dir.description: Shared fastq download cache (a Nextflow storeDir).
ena_cache_dir.help_text: Every ENA run accession is downloaded exactly once, across samples and across N values. Point it somewhere with room and keep it between runs. Expect hundreds of GB.

branchwater_options.title: Branchwater options
branchwater_options.description: Sketching and searching the public metagenome index.

branchwater_index.description: sourmash rocksdb index searched by manysearch.

branchwater_metadata_db.description: Branchwater metadata DuckDB, used to resolve hits to ENA runs.

branchwater_k.description: k-mer size. Must match the index.

branchwater_threshold.description: Minimum containment for a hit to be considered.

assembler.help_text: metaSPAdes is the default. megahit is the escape hatch for cycle-2 datasets too deep to assemble in the available memory: a fraction of the memory and time, at the cost of a more fragmented assembly. Every slot in a run uses the same assembler, so the comparison stays internally consistent.

assembly_memory.description: Memory in GB for the assembler, +50% per retry.
assembly_memory.help_text: Can be overridden per sample with `meta.assembly_memory`.

spades_only_assembler.description: Pass --only-assembler to metaSPAdes, skipping read error correction.

max_spades_retries.description: Retries for metaSPAdes, each with 50% more memory.

spades_version.description: Recorded in meta.assembler_version and part of the assembly publish path.

megahit_version.description: Recorded in meta.assembler_version and part of the assembly publish path.

assembly_qc_options.title: Assembly QC options
assembly_qc_options.description: What leaves the assembler and reaches genomes-generation.

short_reads_min_contig_length.description: Contigs shorter than this are dropped, and it is QUAST's --min-contig.

short_reads_contig_threshold.description: An assembly with fewer contigs than this fails QC and produces no MAG.

short_reads_low_reads_count_threshold.description: Fewer reads than this after fastp marks the run QC-failed.

short_reads_filter_ratio_threshold.description: fastp keeping this fraction of the reads or less is a QC failure.

min_qcov.description: Query coverage floor for filterpaf, which decides what counts as a contaminant contig hit.

decontamination_options.title: Decontamination references
decontamination_options.description: Resolved as <reference_genomes_folder>/<name>/<name>.fna, so these are directory names, not paths.

contaminant_reference.description: Optional extra host or contaminant genome.

skip_prok.description: Skip the prokaryotic branch. Keep this true: this is a eukaryotic workflow.

skip_euk.description: Skip the eukaryotic branch, which is the one producing the MAGs being compared.

skip_decontamination.description: Skip GGP's own read decontamination against --ref_genome.

skip_preprocessing_input.description: Skip GGP's input preprocessing. Keep this true: it expects ENA-derived inputs and ours are not.

merge_pairs.description: Merge overlapping read pairs in GGP's fastp step.

min_contig_size.description: Minimum contig length fed to the binners.

metabat2_rng_seed.description: MetaBAT2's --seed, fixed so binning is reproducible.

publish_all.description: GGP's own switch for publishing its intermediates. The genomes are published regardless.

ena_assembly_study_accession.description: Prefix on GGP's report file names. NOT an accession, unless uploads are on.

subdir_euks.description: Name of GGP's euks output subdirectory.

subdir_proks.description: Name of GGP's proks output subdirectory.

subdir_rna.description: Name of GGP's rna output subdirectory.

subdir_taxonomy.description: Name of GGP's taxonomy output subdirectory.

subdir_stats.description: Name of GGP's stats output subdirectory.

subdir_coverage.description: Name of GGP's coverage output subdirectory.

subdir_bins.description: Name of GGP's bins output subdirectory.

subdir_mags.description: Name of GGP's mags output subdirectory.

ena_upload_options.title: ENA upload options
ena_upload_options.description: genomes-generation's uploader. All off, and these submit for real.

upload_mags.description: Submit the dereplicated MAGs to ENA.
upload_mags.help_text: Needs the Nextflow secrets WEBIN_ACCOUNT and WEBIN_PASSWORD, and --ena_assembly_study_accession set to a registered ENA study. Try --test_upload true first.

test_upload.description: Submit to ENA's test service instead of live.

eukcc_db.description: EukCC reference data: taxonomy and completeness/contamination.

ref_genome.description: GGP's decontamination reference. Read even when --skip_decontamination is on, so it must point at a real file.

inert_options.title: Inert options
inert_options.description: Declared because the composed submodules resolve them at config time, but never reached by this pipeline's path. Listed so that nobody spends an afternoon tuning one.

checkm2_db.description: Prokaryotic branch only, and --skip_prok is true.

gunc_db.description: Prokaryotic branch only, and --skip_prok is true.

gtdbtk_db.description: Prokaryotic branch only, and --skip_prok is true.

rfam_rrna_models.description: Prokaryotic branch only, and --skip_prok is true.

long_reads_min_read_length.description: miassembler's long-read path. Only SHORT_READS_ASSEMBLER is called.

long_reads_ont_quality_threshold.description: miassembler's long-read path. Only SHORT_READS_ASSEMBLER is called.

long_reads_pacbio_quality_threshold.description: miassembler's long-read path. Only SHORT_READS_ASSEMBLER is called.

max_flye_retries.description: miassembler's long-read path. Only SHORT_READS_ASSEMBLER is called.

diamond_db.description: miassembler's frameshift correction, long reads only.

private_study.description: miassembler's ENA fetch path, replaced by our samplesheet.

study_accession.description: Fallback only, meta always carries one.

reads_accession.description: Fallback only, meta always carries one.

download_data.description: GGP's ENA download path, replaced by our samplesheet.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

singularity_cachedir.description: Shared Singularity image cache, used by -profile codon as singularity.cacheDir.
